performance_quality.smart_note: Device read requires administrator access; media health was not assessed.
performance_quality.event_association: Conservative approximate generation windows using file-harvest time and the configured 30-second NVMe timeout; events are device-wide, not process-attributed.
performance_quality.claim: Fault-affected descriptive timings, unsuitable for establishing stable algorithmic speedup.

measurement_notes: Per-setting results have two observations, not confidence intervals. Raw ranges show SSD variance.
Same-placement speedup uses the mean of the two neighboring AR wall times.
Capacity AR uses the same 8 GiB total budget and 512 MiB runtime reserve; it is not adjacent to every speculative case.
31 post-prefill token intervals are timed for 32 emitted tokens; prefill, model load, setup and warmups are excluded.
SSD pread times are nested inside draft/verification/AR wall times; do not add both totals.
Non-pread residuals include GPU work, transfers, routing, open/close and synchronization, not pure compute.
The native draft_compute_ms field excludes only fork snapshot/restore; it still includes SSD I/O and control work.
External copy timings cover snapshot/restore/commit; verification history writes remain in verification.
GPU/CPU power clocks and caches were not changed. Shared machine, direct SSD I/O, allocation guard rather than cgroup limit.
